coursera.headline_style: aspirational career transformation (e.g., 'Unlimited learning', 'Start, switch, or advance your career')
coursera.pricing_model: free to join, pay per course/specialization, subscription for Coursera Plus

udemy.body_font: "Udemy Sans", "Noto Sans JP", Vazirmatn, "SF Pro Text", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
udemy.headline_style: skill-based, career-outcome focused (e.g., 'Learn essential career and life skills', 'Reshape your career in the AI era')
udemy.pricing_model: per-course purchase, frequent discounts/sales, personal subscription plan available
unique_patterns: no traditional H1 on landing page

masterclass.headline_style: cinematic, aspirational, all-caps condensed (e.g., 'LEARN FROM THE BEST, BE YOUR BEST.')
key_sections: personalization quiz ('What brings you to MasterClass?')
masterclass.pricing_model: annual subscription (3 tiers), starting at ~£10/month billed annually
unique_patterns: entire site is dark theme (body bg #000000)
custom condensed typeface for cinematic feel
custom font files (.woff2 self-hosted, not Google Fonts)
multi-product bundle (Accelerator: MasterClass + Certificates + On Call)

khan_academy.headline_style: mission-driven, inclusive (e.g., 'Khan Academy boosts scores!', 'You can learn anything.', 'Every child deserves the chance to learn.')
key_sections: mega category navigation (accordion-style: Math, Science, Computing, ELA, Test Prep, etc.)
Why Khan Academy works (3-column: personalized, trusted, empowering)
key supporters logos (Bank of America, Gates Foundation, etc.)
trust_signals: 90% of US teachers found Khan Academy effective
unique_patterns: prominent Donate button alongside Sign up
key supporters section with foundation logos
combines K-12 + college + life skills in one nav

palette.primary_role: Header, navigation, links, trust elements, footer (blue conveys trust, knowledge, authority; purple for marketplace accessibility; crimson for cinematic luxury)
palette.accent_role: CTA buttons, course category badges, progress indicators, highlights, sale badges
palette.surface_role: Page backgrounds, card backgrounds, alternating sections; #000000/#0d0d0e for dark-themed luxury education brands
palette.neutral_role: Body text, secondary text, metadata, course details, instructor info
palette.border_role: Card borders, input fields, dividers, course cards

button_styles.bg: primary blue (#0056d2) or purple (#a435f0) or crimson (#e32652)
button_styles.text: action-oriented (Enroll Now, Start Learning, Get Started Free, Join Course, Begin Your Journey, Get MasterClass)
Browse Courses, View Curriculum, Meet Instructors, Learn More, Log In
Navigation, View All, See More, FAQ, Explore
Category chips, filter options, quiz answers

elevation.shadows: clean, moderate; some brands (Udemy) use flat design with no shadows

typical_order: header (sticky, white/transparent/dark bg, logo left, nav center with courses/categories, 'Sign In' + 'Get Started' CTA right)
hero (headline + subtitle + primary CTA + secondary CTA + hero image/illustration + social proof: 'Join 10M+ learners')
partner_logos_or_stats (university logos or stat counters: students, courses, graduation rate, job placement rate)
courses_grid (3-4 columns: course card with thumbnail, title, instructor, rating, price/duration, level badge, CTA)
how_it_works (numbered steps: Browse -> Enroll -> Learn -> Certificate, or platform walkthrough illustration)
instructors (photo cards: headshot, name, credentials, courses taught, rating, bio link)
curriculum (accordion or tabbed: module/section breakdown with lesson titles, duration, preview availability)
testimonials (student photo + quote + name + course taken + outcome: 'Got a job at Google', 'Doubled my salary')
pricing (tier cards or simple table: plan name, price, features, CTA, 'Most Popular' badge)
faq (accordion: cost, prerequisites, time commitment, certificate value, refund policy)
enrollment_cta (centered: 'Ready to start learning?' + primary CTA + 'No risk, money-back guarantee' reassurance)
footer (4-column: about/platform/courses/support + copyright + social links + accreditation logos)
hero_variants: illustration_right (text left + educational illustration/graphic right -- Coursera, edX style)
search_centered (large course search bar: 'What do you want to learn?' -- Udemy style)
video_hero (background video of classroom/students + overlay text + CTA -- university style)
stat_banner (large headline + counter stats: '500+ courses, 50K+ students, 98% satisfaction')
minimal_text (clean, centered headline + subtitle + CTA, no image -- bootcamp style)
cinematic_dark (all-caps condensed headline on black, celebrity imagery, crimson CTA -- MasterClass style)
personalization_quiz_hero (dark bg + headline + multi-checkbox quiz: 'What brings you here today?' + disabled Continue until selection -- MasterClass style)
mission_hero (large headline on colored/illustrated bg + persona CTAs: Learner/Teacher/Parent + search bar -- Khan Academy style)
segment_nav_hero (top banner nav for different segments: Individual/Business/University/Government + headline below -- Coursera style)
course_card_variants: thumbnail_badge (course image top, level badge corner, title + instructor + rating + price + CTA below)
list_detail (horizontal: small thumbnail left, title + metadata right, price + CTA right -- compact)
curriculum_card (module count, hours of content, projects included, certificate badge -- bootcamp style)
cinematic_card (instructor photo prominent, class title, duration, 'new' badge, watch trailer CTA -- MasterClass style)
flat_marketplace_card (no shadow, no border, thumbnail + long title + instructor + rating stars + price with currency -- Udemy style)
navigation_variants: sticky_top_bar (logo left, center nav links, right auth CTAs -- Coursera, Khan Academy)
dark_top_bar (all-dark header with search bar, browse menu, CTA -- MasterClass)
mega_category_nav (large expandable accordion with 12+ subject areas, each with 5-20 sublinks -- Khan Academy)
segment_switcher (top banner with For Individuals / For Business / For University / For Government tabs -- Coursera)
search_heavy_nav (search bar central to header -- Udemy style)

tone_profile.headline_style: aspirational, benefit-driven (e.g., 'Learn the skills to shape your future', 'Advance your career with expert-led courses', 'From curious to career-ready', 'LEARN FROM THE BEST, BE YOUR BEST.')
tone_profile.cta_style: encouraging, low-risk (Start Learning Free, Enroll Now, Begin Your Journey, Try for Free, Join Today, Get MasterClass)

tone_by_brand_type.mooc_platform: trustworthy, academic, institutional (Coursera/edX: 'Advance your career with courses from top universities')
tone_by_brand_type.marketplace: accessible, skill-focused, practical (Udemy: 'Learn essential career and life skills')
tone_by_brand_type.nonprofit_k12: mission-driven, inclusive, warm (Khan Academy: 'You can learn anything. Every child deserves the chance to learn.')
tone_by_brand_type.luxury_celebrity: cinematic, aspirational, exclusive-feeling (MasterClass: 'LEARN FROM THE BEST, BE YOUR BEST.')
tone_by_brand_type.career_bootcamp: bold, urgent, outcome-focused (General Assembly: 'Change your career in 12 weeks')

trust_signals: instructor credentials (PhD, industry experience, published authors, celebrities)
course ratings and review counts (star ratings 4.0-4.9)
money-back guarantee or free trial (30-day money-back standard)
major foundation supporters (Gates Foundation, Bank of America, etc.)
anti_patterns: fake urgency ('Only 2 spots left!' when course is self-paced)
vague learning outcomes ('you will learn a lot')
stock photos of 'students' in unnatural poses

color_mood: blue_trust (Coursera/edX: #0056d2 primary, white bg, blue links, clean sans -- academic, trustworthy)
purple_creative (Udemy/Brilliant: #a435f0 primary, white/light bg, creative-purple accent -- marketplace, approachable)
green_growth (Khan Academy/Duolingo: #00a86b primary, white bg, playful illustrations -- friendly, growth)
dark_career (General Assembly/BloomTech: #1a1a2e primary, #ff6b35 orange accent, bold, career-focused)
gold_tradition (university: #002f6c navy, #f5a623 gold accent, Source Serif headings -- traditional, prestigious)
dark_cinematic (MasterClass: #000000 bg, #e32652 crimson CTA, #ffffff text, Sohne Schmal condensed headings -- luxurious, exclusive, celebrity-driven)
typography_mood: modern_sans (Inter/Poppins/Source Sans Pro -- contemporary edtech, accessible, clean)
academic_serif (Source Serif 4 headings + Inter body -- university/traditional, scholarly)
friendly_rounded (Nunito Sans/Lato -- K-12, tutoring, approachable and warm)
cinematic_condensed (Sohne Schmal/Impact -- luxury education, celebrity-focused, dramatic)
custom_brand_sans (Udemy Sans/Equinox Sans -- proprietary brand identity, unique recognition)
layout_density: spacious_academic (university/MOOC: large hero, generous whitespace, curated feel)
marketplace_dense (Udemy: category grid, many course cards, search prominent, filter-heavy)
conversion_focused (bootcamp: longer pages, strong outcome stats, enrollment CTA repeated)
cinematic_spread (MasterClass: full-bleed dark backgrounds, large hero type, carousel-driven, high visual drama)
nonprofit_mission (Khan Academy: clear hierarchy, persona branching, donation integrated, supporter logos)
pricing_display: per_course (Udemy: individual course prices with frequent discounts, e.g., £99.99)
subscription_annual (MasterClass: 3 tiers, starting at ~£10/month, billed annually)
free_plus_pay (Coursera: free to audit, pay for certificate/specialization)
completely_free (Khan Academy: donation-supported nonprofit, 'Always free for learners and teachers')
subscription_monthly (Pluralsight/Skillshare: flat monthly fee for full library)

course_detail.best_practices: Clear learning objectives, syllabus/module breakdown, preview video, prerequisites, time commitment, certificate details, instructor credentials

pricing_page.best_practices: Clear tier differentiation, annual/monthly toggle if applicable, enterprise/team plan, financial aid info

observed_2026_06_02_trends.color_spaces: Udemy has fully adopted oklch() color space for all colors, replacing hex/rgb throughout CSS
observed_2026_06_02_trends.custom_fonts: Both MasterClass and Udemy use self-hosted custom brand fonts (.woff2) rather than Google Fonts -- growing trend for brand differentiation
observed_2026_06_02_trends.dark_theme: MasterClass uses a full dark theme (body bg #000000) as a differentiator -- rare in education, more common in entertainment/streaming
observed_2026_06_02_trends.personalization_quiz: MasterClass uses an interactive checkbox quiz in the hero to personalize the experience before showing CTAs
observed_2026_06_02_trends.flat_design: Udemy has moved to a flat card design with no shadows and no borders on course cards
observed_2026_06_02_trends.persona_branching: Khan Academy splits CTAs by persona (Learner/Teacher/Parent) both in header and throughout the page
observed_2026_06_02_trends.segment_navigation: Coursera uses a top-level segment switcher (Individual/Business/University/Government) as primary navigation
observed_2026_06_02_trends.ai_positioning: Coursera and Udemy both prominently feature AI-related courses and career transformation in AI era messaging
observed_2026_06_02_trends.nonprofit_trust: Khan Academy prominently displays its 501(c)(3) status and major foundation supporters as trust signals
observed_2026_06_02_trends.carousel_heavy: MasterClass relies heavily on carousels (instructors, trending, testimonials, coming soon) rather than static grids
